name: @pipeworx/mcp-boardgamegeek

tools.name: bgg_get_games
tools.description: Get BoardGameGeek details for up to 20 games by BoardGameGeek id: name, year, player count, play time, categories, mechanics, designers, and community statistics (rating, rank, weight, owners). Requires your own BoardGameGeek application token as _apiKey.

ids.description: BoardGameGeek game ids, 1 to 20. Example: [174430] for Gloomhaven.

include_stats.description: Include ratings, ranks and weight (default true).

_apiKey.description: Your BoardGameGeek application token (register an application with BoardGameGeek to get one). Sent as a Bearer credential.

tools.name: bgg_search_games
tools.description: Search BoardGameGeek for board games and expansions by name. Returns BoardGameGeek ids to pass to bgg_get_games. Requires your own BoardGameGeek application token as _apiKey.

include_expansions.description: Also return expansions (default false: base games only).

limit.description: Max results to return (default 25, max 100). The response carries total and truncated.

_apiKey.description: Your BoardGameGeek application token (register an application with BoardGameGeek to get one). Sent as a Bearer credential.

tools.name: bgg_hot_games
tools.description: The BoardGameGeek "hot" list: the 50 board games currently trending on BoardGameGeek, in rank order. Requires your own BoardGameGeek application token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your BoardGameGeek application token (register an application with BoardGameGeek to get one). Sent as a Bearer credential.

tools.name: bgg_user_collection
tools.description: A BoardGameGeek member's game collection (owned, wishlist, rated). Requires your own BoardGameGeek application token as _apiKey. Large collections are queued upstream and may take a retry.

owned_only.description: Only games the member owns (default true).

limit.description: Max rows (default 50, max 500). The response carries total and truncated.

_apiKey.description: Your BoardGameGeek application token (register an application with BoardGameGeek to get one). Sent as a Bearer credential.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-boardgamegeek forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the boardgamegeek pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
